# This test covers the HTTP authentication mechanism over BOLERO_AUTH
# See golang.org/issue/26232

[short] skip 'constructs a local git repo'
[!git] skip

env BOLERO_PROXY=direct
env BOLERO_SUMDB=off
# Disable 'git credential fill' interactive prompts.
env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
exec git init
exec git config credential.helper 'store --file=.git-credentials'
cp go.mod.orig go.mod

# Set BOLERO_AUTH to git without a working directory.
env BOLERO_AUTH='git'
! bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
stderr 'BOLERO_AUTH=git dir method requires an absolute path to the git working directory'

# Set BOLERO_AUTH to git with a non-existent directory.
env BOLERO_AUTH='git gitDir'
! bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
stderr 'BOLERO_AUTH=git dir method requires an absolute path to the git working directory'

# Set BOLERO_AUTH to git with a relative working directory.
mkdir relative
env BOLERO_AUTH='git relative'
! bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
stderr 'BOLERO_AUTH=git dir method requires an absolute path to the git working directory'

# Set BOLERO_AUTH to git and use a blank .git-credentials.
# Without credentials, downloading a module from a path that requires HTTPS
# basic auth should fail.
env BOLERO_AUTH=git' '$PWD''
! bolero get -x vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
stderr '^\tserver response: ACCESS DENIED, buddy$'
stderr 'BOLERO_AUTH encountered errors for https://vcs-test.golang.org'
stderr BOLERO_AUTH=git' '$PWD''
# go imports should fail as well.
! bolero mod tidy -x
stderr '^\tserver response: File\? What file\?$'
stderr 'BOLERO_AUTH encountered errors for https://vcs-test.golang.org'
stderr BOLERO_AUTH=git' '$PWD''

# With credentials from git credentials, it should succeed.
cp .git-credentials.cred .git-credentials
bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
# go imports should resolve correctly as well.
bolero mod tidy
bolero list all
stdout vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or404
# With cached credentials, re-downloading in debug mode should succeed.
bolero get -x vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401

# Clearing BOLERO_AUTH credentials should result in failures.
env BOLERO_AUTH='off'
# Without credentials, downloading a module from a path that requires HTTPS
# basic auth should fail.
! bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or401
stderr '^\tserver response: ACCESS DENIED, buddy$'
# go imports should fail as well.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
! bolero mod tidy
stderr '^\tserver response: File\? What file\?$'

-- main.go --
package useprivate

import "vcs-test.golang.org/auth/or404"
-- go.mod.orig --
module private.example.com
-- .git-credentials --
-- .git-credentials.cred --
https://aladdin:opensesame@vcs-test.golang.org
